purpose: Paired diagnostic of whether maintained GEOS simplification reduces grid zigzag/scheduled turns without relaxing any independent validation requirement

algorithm.scope: Each fixed clearanceGrid inner graph chain independently; preserve requested connectors plus first/last original graph edges
algorithm.coordinatePolicy: Input uses original XZ. Reattach exact original XYZ only after strict ordered-source-subsequence and endpoint equality checks. Ambiguous repeated XZ or generated/interpolated coordinate refuses the whole candidate.

requiredChecks.nativeCorridor: Reuse unchanged native.segment(a,b) AND native.segment(b,a) on every complete segment including original requested connectors; rejection/error/unknown cannot pass.
requiredChecks.independent2D: Reuse unchanged validator.validate; full segment distances to supplied obstacles and coverage boundary; radius hypot(.45,.30)/2 + .15 = .42041634565979924 m, guard 1e-8 m. Do not infer or borrow absent geometry.
requiredChecks.full3D: Still required for exact rectangular body, separate margin, swept rotations/translations, support/currentness and geometry association; fewer vertices is not acceptance.
requiredChecks.sourceIntegrity: Baseline proposals, endpoints, body schedules, mesh and native configuration remain immutable.
requiredChecks.detourPolicy: Recompute full-XYZ lengths and retain original unfiltered shortest-grid cap; no relaxation.
requiredChecks.authority: physicalAuthority false, movementExecuted false; no default/native app activation.
requiredChecks.diagnosticEligibility: Verified unchanged-native all-segment pass is required before later full-body diagnostic; missing independent coverage remains unknown and blocks acceptance, not the diagnostic. Explicit 2D rejection is retained and blocks diagnostic eligibility.
requiredChecks.fullReconstructedTopology: GEOS simple-line check on complete reconstructed XZ chain after locked-edge and connector reattachment; false blocks later-body diagnostic eligibility without moving coordinates.

knownBlocker: Conference has no admitted complete independent floor/body/head 2D projection/coverage contract. Existing validator clear status is authored-fixture-only; real candidate must remain unknown, never a physical pass.
